note: A Tal descriptor that also lists a delivered blank code. The blank row is no member (maintainer decision 2026-10-09: a delivered blank code is missing data), so the descriptor is still a complete recognized marker. The documented certificate keeps its marker binding and publishes the enumerated 2020 codes.
fails_if: `bind_occurrence_code_lists` (source_value_bindings.py) counts the skipped blank row in `ValueListBinding.association_count`, so `marker_binding_fingerprints` sees more associations than marker rows and certifies nothing: the certificate's `marker_bindings` placeholder cannot be rendered and the documented coding goes stale

sources.description: VALUE defined by a numbered enumeration in 2020 (member 1001), whose Tal descriptor lists the Tal marker row and a delivered blank code labelled 'Uppgift saknas'.
